city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is good.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Connectorov opis VMA kao velikog pražnjenja: prikazani broj slobodnih mesta porastao je sa 105 na 504, ali bez vremena merenja ne mogu da utvrdim stvarne odlaske vozila. Takođe ne mogu da pretvorim Observerovo povezivanje sa Grockom u dokaz kvara: naslov najavljuje planirane radove, dok se BVK-ov nemi izvor odnosi na neplanirane kvarove i auto-cisterne. [F6][F7][F13]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Connector's description of VMA as a large emptying: displayed free spaces rose from 105 to 504, but without measurement times I cannot establish actual vehicle departures [F6]. I also cannot turn Observer's Grocka juxtaposition into evidence of a fault: the headline announces planned works, while BVK's silent feed concerns unplanned faults and water tankers [F7][F13].
